svg.text: What the Focal Loss Actually Does
The (1-p)^γ factor shrinks the loss on examples the model already gets right
pt, the probability given to the correct class (easy examples to the right)
Raising γ suppresses easy examples so a flood of easy negatives cannot dominate training.
